## Measurement (step 1 of the card) — premise confirmed, and a bare rollback under two holders is a SILENT PICK

Measured over HTTP on a booted showcase (`bootShowcase` from `packages/qa/dogfood`, the composition `objectstack serve` composes) at `objectstack-ai/objectstack@47f6c939`, with two extra `AppPlugin` packages of two namespaces, `com.qa.hist.alpha` and `com.qa.hist.beta`, each shipping one flow `qa_hist_shared`. The console step is read from the code path (`ResourceHistoryPage.tsx` calls `client.history(type, name)` / `client.rollback(type, name, version)`, and the client sends no package), not driven in a browser.

### A. Shipped two-holder flow, each holder edited in its writable pair

`POST /packages/com.qa.hist.{alpha,beta}/ensure-customization` → 201 each; then `PUT /meta/flow/qa_hist_shared?package=com.qa.hist.P.custom` (declared override of P), twice per holder: versions 1, 3 are alpha's, 2, 4 are beta's.

| Request | Status | What it answered |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `GET /meta/flow/qa_hist_shared` | 409 | `RESOURCE_CONFLICT`, candidates alpha and beta (the plain read refuses, as expected) |
| `GET /meta/flow/qa_hist_shared/layers?package=com.qa.hist.alpha` | 200 | alpha's layers |
| `GET /meta/flow/qa_hist_shared/history` | **200** | all four versions of BOTH packages interleaved in one timeline, no package on any event |
| `GET .../history?package=com.qa.hist.alpha` (also `.custom`, beta's `.custom`) | 400 | `VALIDATION_ERROR`: "package" is not supported; supported: limit, member, sinceSeq |
| `POST .../rollback` `{toVersion: 1}` (alpha's) | 200 | alpha.custom's row restored to "alpha edit 1"; beta's unchanged |
| `POST .../rollback` `{toVersion: 2}` (beta's) | 403 | `NOT_OVERRIDABLE`: "'flow/qa_hist_shared' in package 'com.qa.hist.alpha.custom' carries overrides, and only 'com.qa.hist.beta.custom' may declare an override of 'com.qa.hist.beta'" — the door tried to write beta's version into alpha's pair; only the override gate stopped it |
| `POST .../rollback?package=com.qa.hist.alpha.custom` | 400 | `VALIDATION_ERROR`: "package" is not supported; supported: member, toVersion |
| `GET .../diff?from=1&to=2` | 200 | diffs alpha's v1 against beta's v2 as if one item's versions |

### B. Runtime flow two writable packages hold (no `overrides`) — the silent pick

`PUT /meta/flow/qa_hist_runtime?package=com.qa.hist.P.custom`, twice per holder (v1, v3 alpha.custom; v2, v4 beta.custom).

| Request | Status | Rows after (read with `?package=`) |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `GET /meta/flow/qa_hist_runtime/history` | 200 | four versions of both packages interleaved |
| `POST .../rollback` `{toVersion: 2}` (beta.custom's version) | **200** | **alpha.custom = "beta r1"** (beta's body written into alpha's row), beta.custom = "beta r2" |
| `POST .../rollback` `{toVersion: 1}` | 200 | alpha.custom = "alpha r1", beta.custom = "beta r2" |
| `POST .../rollback` `{toVersion: 4}` (beta.custom's) | **200** | **alpha.custom = "beta r2"**, beta.custom unchanged |

So the bare rollback addresses one holder (alpha.custom here) whatever version it is given, and writes another package's version into it. Per the card's grade line, a silent pick ⇒ p1; the seat has been told.

### Producer

The REST doors (`packages/rest/src/meta-item-history-routes.ts`) call the protocol (`historyMetaItem`, `rollbackMetaItem`, `diffMetaItem` in `packages/metadata-protocol`), which reads and restores `sys_metadata_history` by `(type, name)` only; the metadata manager's package-aware path (`MetadataManager.getHistory` / `rollback` with `packageId`, which refuses a bare two-holder name 409) is not on this route.

### Fix shape (building now)

Bare history / rollback of a name two packages hold → 409 naming both, nothing written; `?package=` (the `/layers?package=` spelling) reads and restores only that holder's versions, and a version of another holder is refused; a one-holder name keeps working bare. Client `history()` / `rollback()` gain the package option and the History tool sends its item page's `?package=`.

Side finding for the report (not fixed here): `GET /meta/flow/qa_hist_runtime` (bare plain read) answered 200 with alpha.custom's flow in shape B, while the shipped two-holder name in shape A answers 409.

## Triage: graded on the measurement (6867256997) · **stays p2** · 2026-11-13T23:12Z

⛔ Not a claim; the grade is unchanged, and the seat keeps building.

- **Measured:** a bare rollback of a runtime flow name that two writable packages hold writes beta's version into **alpha's** `.custom` row (`{toVersion: 2}` → alpha.custom = "beta r1"), answers 200, and leaves no trace. The shipped two-holder shape is stopped only by the override gate (403). History and diff interleave both packages' versions.
- **Row:** one package's flow body silently replaced by another's is silently wrong data, which is p1 (#32997 north-star change).
- **Reach discount (−1 → p2):** it needs two installed packages, each with a customization pair holding the same runtime flow name, which is a rare configuration. The loss is **recoverable**: the overwritten version is still in history, and the same door restores it, so the "unrecoverable loss" exemption does not apply. There is no escalation either: an entitled admin drives the rollback.
- **Correction to my own note:** the order table (6866737306) said "silent pick ⇒ p1". That skipped the reach discount, and #32997 applies it here as it did to the sibling cases: #33131 item 3 (the wrong action body runs, p2) and #33127 (a customization silently reverts after a restart, p2). The three stay consistent at p2.
- The seat's fix shape is right (bare two-holder history/rollback → 409 naming both; `?package=` scopes to one holder; a one-holder name stays bare). The side finding (a bare plain read answers 200 with alpha's flow in shape B) belongs to #32607, the bare read of two stored-row holders, which `epic:#31527#2` holds. It is not a new card.
